name: codeforces-growth-planner
description: Personalized 90-day Codeforces training planner. Don't guess what to practice. Know exactly what to solve next.

scripts.dev:server: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w server
scripts.dev:client: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w client
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w server
